2034-2557-5220-6961-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2557-5220-6961-8347.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Sela triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2105-4598-7297-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-7297-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-7297-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

176-4247-4875.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4247-4875.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

678-5865-8095.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-5865-8095.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat.

4681-5170-6794-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2393-4279-4699--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-4699--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3525-6723-8230.easyPrerequisites: Seedship Agrarian doesn't have summoning sickness.
3525-6723-8230.description:
Activate Seedship Agrarian by tapping it, adding {U}.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6559-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-4779-5131-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4779-5131-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

2724-3963-3987.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-3963-3987.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Meneldor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

64-4377-5144.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Warden of the Eye and exiling Ephemerate.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6438-7175.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6438-7175.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

586-1368-1745-6578.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
586-1368-1745-6578.description:
Cast Priest of Gix from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Lord of the Forsaken ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast spells from your graveyard.
Repeat.
586-1368-1745-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

2292-3025-5170-6132.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1965-2034-5224-6967.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Omarthis, adding {C}{C}.
When Omarthis dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1385-3944-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1978-4188-5056.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
1978-4188-5056.description:
Cause Accomplished Alchemist to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat from step 2.

5231-5968-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2577-2811-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-2811-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3602-6798--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3602-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

586-2292-5258-5618-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
586-2292-5258-5618-6747.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

864-4067-5527-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
864-4067-5527-6281.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Eternal Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Eternal Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
2079-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

3887-5195-6259.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {B}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Lab Rats.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3674-6185-6280.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in hand.
3674-6185-6280.description:
Activate Necroplasm's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it, causing you to mill a number of cards and return Necroplasm from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability.
Repeat.

2525-3967-6132.description:
Cast Metamorphosis Fanatic by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Body Double.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1541-2034-4719-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Anarchist, adding {C}{C}.
When Anarchist dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Anarchist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Anarchist from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating five tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Anarchist and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers five times and Anarchist triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Anarchist trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3347-3525-3883.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Lore Broker.
Lore Broker does not have summoning sickness.
3347-3525-3883.description:
Activate Lore Broker by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and create a Treasure artifact token for each opponent you have, then causing each player to discard a card.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Lore Broker.
Repeat.
If you have two or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

457-1379-2043-4893.description:
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Training Grounds token, adding {U}.
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {2}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Training Grounds token, adding {U}.
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {1}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Training Grounds token, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 5.

1354-2436-2635.notablePrerequisites: Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
1354-2436-2635.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{G}{G}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Marwyn +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Marwyn.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Repeat.

176-2837-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other non-Spirit you control.
The creature dies, triggering Requiem Angel, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

813-1181-3905.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying {4}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Sacrifice and Unbreakable Bond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-4871-5003-5256.description:
Sacrifice Priest of Gix to Altar of Dementia, milling target opponent for 2.
Pitiless Plunderer and Nim Deathmantle triggers; resolve them in that order.
Pitiless Plunderer generates a Treasure token, crack it to float {B}.
Resolve Nim Deathmantle's triggered ability, paying {4} to recur Priest of Gix to the battlefield (spending initial {3}).
Priest of Gix's ETB trigger adds three {B}.
Repeat from the top, milling target opponent infinitely.
